phrase: A top AI lab lets an outside watchdog publish freely. Its own safety bill only kicks in after fifty deaths or a billion dollars in damage.
phraseAlternatives: A lab gave an outside watchdog free rein to publish. Its own safety bill waits for fifty deaths or a billion dollars in damage.
An AI lab lets a watchdog roam freely inside. Its proposed law only wakes up after fifty deaths or a billion dollars in damage.
One lab opens its doors wide to an outside watchdog. The safety law it wrote only starts after fifty deaths or a billion dollars in damage.
alt: A blueprint illustration split by a dashed vertical line. Left: a building with an open door; a small robot sits at a desk inside while a person with a badge on their chest walks toward the door. Right: a person points proudly up at a wall dial whose needle rests near empty, with only a thin zone marked yellow at the very top.

brief.concept: An AI lab throws its own door wide open for an outside watchdog to walk in past its chatbot, while across the room it points proudly at a safety-law dial that only reacts once the needle nearly maxes out.
brief.metaphor: Self-policing looks generous up close, but the rule it wrote for everyone else only switches on after a catastrophe.

a small chatbot robot seated at a desk just inside the doorway
a human inspector stepping through the open doorway, holding up a badge
a large wall-mounted dial with its needle resting near empty and a tiny red zone at the very top
a human spokesperson standing beside the dial, pointing at it proudly
